title: Best Multimeter (2026)
summary: A concise guide to the top multimeters for 2026, highlighting the best overall pick and its key advantages.
method: Selected products were chosen from the cited sources (TechGearLab, Automoblog, Tom’s Guide, Yahoo Shopping). The top pick appears in the most detailed review and is rated best overall by TechGearLab. Other picks were included because they are mentioned in multiple sources and cover specific use cases.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price information is included.

products.name: Fluke 115 Digital Multimeter
why: Fluke 115 is highlighted as a budget automotive multimeter on Automoblog and Yahoo Shopping.
It is praised for its easy readability and accuracy for basic automotive diagnostics.
products.desc: The Fluke 115 is a handheld digital multimeter that measures voltage, current, and resistance. It features a clear display and is designed for automotive use. It does not include a clamp meter.
products.benefit: Picture a car owner checking a battery before a trip. The Fluke 115 provides quick, accurate voltage readings and a large, easy‑to‑read display. It is the only automotive‑focused meter in this guide that is specifically marketed for beginners. The catch: it lacks advanced functions like a built‑in clamp meter.
products.skip_if: You need advanced diagnostics or a clamp meter
